'''Corrsk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] member of [[Diversity Alliance]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]. He was part of [[Nolaa Tarkona]]'s inner council and a general in the Alliance military forces. Corrsk represented the Trandoshan species in the organization. He also was easily stirred and enraged.

As many others in the Diversity Alliance, Corrsk loathed the [[Human/Legends|human]] species for the atrocities of the [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. On one occasion, he was wounded twice by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Lowbacca]], who had turned against the organization after having learned what had become of his four human [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] companions; the first instance was when Lowbacca's [[Lowbacca's lightsaber|lightsaber]] made a [[Shiim/Legends|cut]] on his shoulder; the other had been when a redirected [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] bolt hit the ceiling section above Corrsk, burying him alive and nearly badly damaging his left leg. This increased the Trandoshan's hatred of Wookiees and Humans.

Later, during the [[Battle of the Emperor's Plague Storehouse]], Corrsk had his right arm [[Cho sun/Legends|sliced off]] by Lowbacca, forcing him to pry his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] from the dead limb with his remaining hand. Before he could fire another shot, Lowbacca launched him out of an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], causing him to slowly die out in space.
